scope: Allocation-failure rollback for the legacy MLEADER DXF group-94 arrowhead index append.

implementation.behavior: The parser checks the existing arrowhead limit and reserves one additional entry before consuming group 94. Failed reserve returns false without publishing an entry; the subsequent push uses the reserved slot.

control.allocationInjection: MaterialAllocationFailure offset 0 targets the guarded vector reserve.
checks: Injected reserve failure occurs exactly once and leaves arrowHeads empty.
Retry group 94 with index 7, then group 345 with handle A10A; both the index and handle are retained.

limits: This covers only legacy MLEADER group-94 vector growth and its following group-345 handle field.
It does not qualify MLEADER physical producer breadth, native annotation semantics, DWG parsing, or complete document conversion.
next: Continue P6 safety review at a separate reproduced parser allocation or rollback boundary; keep native and whole-document qualification gates open.
